test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A sum of money, when invested at the rate of 6.25% simple interest per annum, amounts to (11)/(8) times of itself in ‘n’ years. What is the value of ‘n’?
solution:
**Given:**

Rate = 6.25% per annum

Time = n years

Amount = 11/8 × Principle

**Concept used:**

SI = A - P

SI = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculations:**

Let the Principle sum be 'x'

S.I. = A − P

⇒ SI = 11/8P − P

⇒ SI = (11P - 8P)/8 = 3P/8

Now SI

3x/8 = (x × 6.25 × n)/100

⇒ 300/8 = 6.25n

⇒ n = 300/(8 × 6.25)

⇒ n = 300/50 = 6 years

**∴ The value of ‘n’ is 6 years.**
